description: Free public 7-day (default) or 30-day aggregation of identifiable large-trader wallet activity for the on-chain venues that expose wallet addresses. Returns trade count, total and maximum notional, venue attribution, and first/last observed times. An absent wallet does not prove absent trading: anonymized venues and unavailable feeds are excluded. This is market context, not a wallet identity guarantee or recommendation. No API key required.

source.description: Restrict results to one wallet-address venue.
